Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the effect of zoning ordinances on motor vehicle collection and restoration.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the effect of zoning ordinances on motor vehiclecollection and restoration; adding a new section to chapter 35.21 RCW;adding a new section to chapter 35.63 RCW; adding a new section tochapter 35A.63 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 36.70 RCW; andadding a new section to chapter 36.70A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided under subsection (2) of this section, a cityor town shall not enact, enforce, or maintain an ordinance, developmentregulation, zoning regulation, or official control, policy, oradministrative practice that prohibits the hobby of collecting andrestoring motor vehicles, including any of the following: (a) Repairing or modifying motor vehicles that are undergoingrestoration; or (b) Maintaining motor vehicles as a source of parts for motorvehicles undergoing restoration. (2) This section does not prohibit a city or town from enacting, p. 1 SB 6403enforcing, or maintaining an ordinance, development regulation, zoningregulation, or official control, policy, or administrative practicethat: (a) Regulates noise, advertising, traffic, hours of operation, orother conditions that may accompany the use of property undersubsection (1) of this section; or (b) Requires parts, motor vehicles, or activities under subsection(1) of this section to be screened from view by fencing, vegetation, orother means.
